problems: All four repaired dossiers validate with 0 errors and 0 warnings (--resolve); read back from the mount after about ten seconds and unchanged.
Not touched (verdict pass, fix or thin): ogedeid-ulus, ariq-boke, ulus-of-hulegu, amirate-of-qazaghan, uzbek-khanate-of-abul-khayr, turpan-khanate.

Open disagreement: ulus-of-chagatai dates the cession of Semirechye and Bukhara to ogedeid-ulus in 1271 (the reviewer's first alternative) although the Chagatai Khanate page dates the peace to 1267 (Kaidu page: c.1267 or 1269). Better fix: ogedeid-ulus starts in 1267 and the loss here moves back to 1267; ogedeid-ulus /ledger/10 (vassal_end 1306, counterpart ulus-of-chagatai) should name chagatai-khanate.

Disagreement with the review: the Kath/Khiva loss (sufi-dynasty-of-khwarazm, 1373) is confidence 1, not 3, because the Sufi dynasty page gives the peace without a year. The Gurganj 400 km circle proposed for Otrar/Khwarazm was replaced in both ulus dossiers by Otrar (200 km) plus the Khwarezm region (the circle covers 436,000 km2 and cuts the Aral steppe).

ulus-of-jochi: a c1 gain of Otrar and Khwarazm in 1225 was added because no page dates the Jochid hold; a reviewer who prefers dropping Khwarazm and the 1263/1267 pair must change both ulus-of-jochi and ulus-of-chagatai.

Mirrors still missing in other groups' dossiers: timurid-empire (Kath and Khiva 1373, vassal tie 1379-1383, Sufi end 1388; its 1402 Khwarazm gain at c1), golden-horde (uses the string 'Sufi dynasty of Khwarazm'; its pre-1294 Rostov-Suzdal slug), four-oirats (should name kara-del by slug), chagatai-khanate (vassal tie to ogedeid-ulus from 1294), mongol-empire (no Tarim or Almaliq loss events).

Vassal-event convention: the schema says the counterpart of vassal_start/_end is the vassal; the reviewer's mirrors put the suzerain in the vassal's own dossier (kara-del to ming-dynasty and four-oirats, sufi to golden-horde and timurid-empire, ulus-of-chagatai to ariq-boke and ogedeid-ulus, ulus-of-jochi's Rostov-Suzdal remains suzerain-side). Followed the reviewer; the renderer must read a vassal_start whose counterpart is the stronger state as 'this state is the vassal'.
kara-del rulers follow the page's list (from the Japanese Wikipedia list as WebFetch returned it), which disagrees with the English text on the first reigns.
